skills.title: Morning Dispatch Board
skills.summary: Coordinate VIP technician recovery, billing hold, dispatch assignment, and customer-facing handoff from the same cited case record.
skills.usefulness_rationale: The pattern spans dispatch, billing, documentation, ticket comments, and Slack updates for a service recovery case.

trigger.description: Use when a VIP service appointment loses the assigned technician while billing or account status can affect the dispatch response.

skills.goal: Stabilize the appointment, preserve billing context, and leave a cited cross-system handoff trail.

steps.instruction: Read the dispatch and field-technician evidence for the appointment risk.
Confirm whether billing hold or dispute state constrains field follow-up.
Write the dispatch handoff with cited appointment, billing, and exception evidence.
